Method of Attack: Hijacking DNS server to replace legitimate Coinhive JavaScript in-browser miner with a malicious version
Malicious script mined Monero for hacker's wallet instead of legitimate site owners
Impacted Systems: Thousands of websites loading the modified Coinhive script
Attack Vector: Hacker logged into Coinhive's Cloudflare account and replaced DNS records to point domain to malicious IP
Indicators of Compromise: Modified coinhive.min.js file with hardcoded site key
New IP address for Coinhive domain
